fixed_residues.description: Space-separated list of residues to hold fixed during sequence design in chain+index format. Mutually exclusive with redesigned_residues.

structure_path.description: TOS URI to the input protein structure in PDB/mmCIF format.

redesigned_residues.description: Space-separated list of residues to redesign in chain+index format. All other residues are held fixed. Mutually exclusive with fixed_residues.
